_about: DESC's 2026-2030 list of transmission projects of $2M and above compared with its 2024-2028 list, both as published on SCRTP. Each row cites both PDF pages. The lists don't say why a date or an estimate changed; the rows state what each list gives.

sources.title: Dominion Energy South Carolina: Planned Transmission Projects $2M and above, 2024-2028 (project descriptions)
Dominion Energy South Carolina: Planned Transmission Projects $2M and above, 2026-2030 (project descriptions)

method.id_key: an id with its spaces, dashes and commas removed and leading zeros dropped ('6853 B-F' = '6853BF', '06810 H' = '6810 H')
method.link: 1) the same id key and the same project (title similarity >= 0.8, or description similarity >= 0.9 when the title changed); 2) a different id: title similarity >= 0.85 and the ids share a work order or base number (or the titles name a place in common), each the other's best match; 3) a different id: description similarity >= 0.9 and the ids share a work order or base number, each the other's best match. A project no step links is dropped (2024-2028 only) or new (2026-2030 only)
method.dates: compared as calendar dates; an impossible date is compared by its month
method.costs: the filed Total of each list

reasons: In-service date readable and 2020-2040: in-service date '04/31/26' could not be read ('04/31/26' is not a valid calendar date)
Every printed date is on the calendar: '04/31/26' is not a real date: April 2026 has 30 days (as printed in the filing; which date was meant can't be told from it)

in_service.note: the 2026-2030 date isn't on the calendar ('04/31/26' is not a real date: April 2026 has 30 days); compared by month

Estimated cost: $12,475,000 (p28) in the 2024-2028 list, $15,775,885 (p1) in the 2026-2030 list, $3,300,885 (26.5 %) higher.
